company.description: Arketa develops a wellness business management platform for fitness studios and wellness professionals. The company provides tools for scheduling, memberships, payments, marketing, client management, branded mobile apps, and on-demand content, enabling businesses to streamline operations, engage clients, and grow revenue through a unified platform.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,829,472 to $78,449,527, a 20.49x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
